test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The administrator will give you a cheque.

options.text: A cheque shall be given to you by the administrator.
A cheque was given to you by the administrator.
A cheque will be given to you by the administrator.
A cheque would be given to you by the administrator.

solution:
The correct answer is "**A cheque will be given to you by the administrator."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Passive voice involves making the object of the active sentence the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• In passive voice, **the object (a cheque)** becomes the subject of the sentence, and **the subject (the administrator)** becomes the object of the preposition **"by."**
 
• The auxiliary verb "will" becomes "will be" in the passive voice.
 
• The past participle form of the main verb "give" is "given" in the passive voice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
